python3 -c "
import hopsworks
import pandas as pd

# Login and get feature store
project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

# Read the batch files
batch_1 = pd.read_csv('data/batch_1.csv')
batch_2 = pd.read_csv('data/batch_2.csv')
batch_3 = pd.read_csv('data/batch_3.csv')

# Combine all batches and keep the latest revision per row_id
all_batches = pd.concat([batch_1, batch_2, batch_3])
latest_revisions = all_batches.sort_values('updated_at', ascending=False).drop_duplicates('row_id')

# Create feature group
fg = fs.create_feature_group(
    name='accounts5fc5d2',
    version=1,
    description='Accounts table with latest revisions per row_id',
    primary_key=['row_id'],
    event_time='updated_at',
    online_enabled=True,
    statistics_config=False
)

# Save the latest revisions to the feature group
fg.save(latest_revisions)

print('Feature group registered and data loaded successfully.')
"
